ModMetaData.name: Caravan Readiness
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
A live readiness report on the hitching spot while a caravan is forming.
- See what is loaded, carried, reserved, waiting, unreachable, or blocked - People, animals, and departure blockers in one place - Click a row to jump to that pawn or item - Reads the vanilla formation process and never forces departure
Requires Harmony and SpineLib.
